title: Corpus Explorer: QA remediation inside current tabs

questions.prompt: Where should notebook titles come from so UUIDs never appear?
questions.description: Today GET /v1/corpus/notebooks fetches titles live (5s timeout) and the Notebook facet ignores them and renders shortId(uuid). Postgres stores no corpus notebook titles.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Persist titles in Postgres (written at ingest and refreshed whenever a live notebooks.list() succeeds); UI shows the cached title, with the short id only as secondary muted text or tooltip.

options.label: Live fetch only; fall back to short id
Persist + allow manual rename/alias in the UI

questions.prompt: Which surfaces must show notebook (and document) titles instead of ids?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Filters sidebar facet, Browse/Search row metadata, Detail pane header, Runs view, breadcrumbs, command palette.

questions.prompt: How should the compressed table be fixed?
questions.description: BrowseTable uses @tanstack/react-table (native column resizing available). SearchResults is a hand-built list, not a table.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Drag-resizable columns in Browse with widths persisted per browser; double-click a handle to reset; text column wraps/expands; column show/hide menu.

options.label: Also convert Search results into the same resizable table

questions.prompt: What should SFL tagging progress look like while it runs (30s+ per chunk)?
questions.description: Progress is reported per parent, so a single-chunk job jumps 0 → done. The Detail pane 'Tag SFL' button only toasts and never follows job events.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Per-child progress from the backend (n of N clauses + current stage text), elapsed timer, a persistent jobs tray in the status footer listing active/recent jobs, and the triggering button shows inline running state until done; on completion the chunk refreshes.

options.label: Jobs tray in status footer (active + recent)

questions.prompt: What backend observability must every SFL tagging job produce?
questions.description: Fact-check runs and TUI jobs open job_span(); the server sfl_tag job opens none and logs nothing.
questions.recommendedAnswer: One Langfuse trace per job via job_span('sfl_tag', job_id, scope); INFO log lines on start, per-parent completion, and finish/failure; trace URL in the job snapshot and shown as a link in the UI.

options.label: INFO logs: start / per-parent / finish / failure
Trace link shown in UI for the job
Same treatment for ingest and other server jobs

questions.description: Canvas scatter of PCA/UMAP-projected embeddings, colored by topic or document, no zoom/pan/legend.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Wheel zoom + drag pan + reset button; legend listing each color with its topic/document title and count (click to isolate); an explainer line stating projection method, what a point is (one chunk), what color encodes, and that distance ≈ semantic similarity; hover tooltip with chunk preview; click opens detail.

options.label: Wheel zoom, drag pan, reset view
Legend with titles + counts, click to isolate
Explainer: method, what a point/color/distance means
Click a point opens Detail pane
Cluster labels drawn on the map (topic names at centroids)

questions.prompt: How should navigation history and breadcrumbs work?
questions.description: setTab uses history.replaceState, so Back never returns to a prior view.
questions.recommendedAnswer: URL encodes tab + open chunk + filters; tab changes and opening a chunk pushState so browser Back/Forward work; breadcrumb bar 'Tab › Notebook › Document › Chunk' with clickable segments using titles.

options.label: Browser Back/Forward across tabs and opened chunks
URL encodes tab, open chunk, filters (shareable/reloadable)

questions.prompt: Confirm what is out of scope for this goal.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Workflow-based IA restructure (Curate → Tag → Verify → Explore) is deferred to a follow-up goal; no changes to SFL tagging model quality/speed; no TUI changes.

options.label: Visual redesign beyond the touched components

questions.prompt: How should the result be verified?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Vitest component tests for each UI fact, pytest for backend title cache / progress / span+logs, Playwright smoke extended for back-nav, map zoom and resize, plus a recorded manual re-run of the original QA script.

options.label: Manual re-run of the QA video script
